entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: No, I believe that is a wise decision.

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: Though it was some third-rate tabloid's[n]article, unnecessary information was[n]leaked, after all.

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: Besides, his investigation of the Phantom[n]Thieves showed no progress since then...

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: Yes, there's a possibility that he'll betray[n]us out of spite since he was let go.

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: Well then, we'll make it so that it was[n]a "heart attack."

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: As usual, he'll be left to deal with the—

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: Oh? I wouldn't have thought of that.[n]Well played, sir.

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: It no longer matters if we deal with[n]one or two of those connected to us.
